trailhead.label: The Passo Nigra (1,688 m), the board’s start

cautions: The Passo Nigra road is busy in summer: keep your dog on a short lead at the start.
Cattle may graze around the Malga Hagner Alm in summer: keep your dog close.
Mountain bikes share the forest road.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.

textIt.Passo Nigra to the Malga Hagner Alm: Da Passo Nigra alla Malga Hagner Alm
textIt.The Passo Nigra (1,688 m), the board’s s: Il Passo Nigra (1.688 m), la partenza della scheda ufficiale
textIt.The Passo Nigra road is busy in summer:: D'estate la strada del Passo Nigra è trafficata: alla partenza tieni il cane al guinzaglio corto.
textIt.Cattle may graze around the Malga Hagner: D'estate attorno alla Malga Hagner Alm possono pascolare i bovini: tieni il cane vicino.
Le mountain bike usano la stessa strada forestale.
